title: Vermont replacing power plants with home batteries
summary: Vermont is implementing a virtual power plant network composed of thousands of home batteries that can collectively replace traditional power plants and keep the lights on during severe storms, demonstrating a scalable model for decentralized clean energy.
problem_solved: Addresses power grid instability during extreme weather events by decentralizing energy generation through aggregated home battery networks.
why_valuable: It demonstrates how residential battery storage can create a resilient, scalable clean energy grid that reduces dependence on centralized fossil fuel power plants while preventing outages.
